bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/menu-idempotent-8dc8d56-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8dc8d5638e7711688be549acf1127ea5bc09b1c1 || exit 60
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container")" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:idem-8dc8d56)" || exit 63
docker logs --since 15m "$container" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 64
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
row="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT count(DISTINCT chat_id) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state='published' AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND chat_id=ANY(ARRAY[-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893]::bigint[])" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
test "$row" = 3 || exit 65
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 66
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 67
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts timeout 75s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu >/tmp/gace-final-11-menu.log 2>&1 || exit 68
grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS$' /tmp/gace-final-11-menu.log || exit 69
grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_MENU_ROWS=3,2,2,3,1$' /tmp/gace-final-11-menu.log || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
echo LIVE_SHARED_IMAGE=PASS
echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY=PASS
echo ALL_THREE_PUBLISHED_POSTING_PANELS=PASS
echo USERBOT_DM_ELEVEN_LABELS_AND_ROWS=PASS
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_PRESERVED=PASS
